pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **"Bubba G, you magnificent madman, you drafted yourself into a battle against your own reflection!"** Now, let me tell you something: France sitting pretty at the top of their group should be a no-brainer, a sure bet, a cornerstone for your fantasy strategy. But then you went and picked Morocco too, because hey, why not pit them against each other in a bizarre act of self-sabotage? This is like drafting the '94 USA team and then saying "but what if we also bet on Brazil?" Bubba G, your dual allegiance is the stuff of Greek tragedies. Look at me—you're setting yourself up to lose no matter who wins! My prediction? France will emerge victorious like a phoenix from your managerial ashes, but let's face it, this is a lose-lose situation, and it speaks volumes about your lack of foresight. Mic drop.
